program.name: Code4rena
program.verdict: Invalid: labelled unsatisfactory, reason Out of scope; sponsor disputed. Submitted as 3 (High Risk).

label.why: The judge marked it unsatisfactory, Out of scope: a Well with more than two tokens is not an acceptable assumption, since Stable2 is compatible with two-token wells only. The sponsor pointed to the contract's own natspec, which says two tokens. The precondition is in the program's ruling; this listing's scope is paths, and the two-token limit is in the source the jury reads.

expected.reason: The judge ruled the three-token well out of scope, so the program's answer is invalid. Every gate passes, because the test really does fail on that well; whether that precondition counts is left to the jury, which A7d measures.
